integrity: Definitions, subformula-bound quantifiers, support-function extension, and finite trace sharpness were checked against the cited primary works; no independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Trace injectivity and r-1 optimality are about homomorphic preservation of a prescribed finite set, not globally smallest countermodels or preservation of arbitrary BALFI axiomatic extensions. The coNP bound follows also from previously published modal-translation and modal-complexity theorems and is not claimed original. The proof is symbolic; finite checker samples are corroboration only.
title: Sharp linear-atom trace preservation for Boolean algebras with LFI operators
